kpis.description_fr: Total clients 6 utilities: ComEd (Illinois), PECO (Pennsylvania), BGE (Maryland), Pepco/DPL/ACE (DMV). Modèle pure-T&D.
kpis.description_en: Total customers 6 utilities: ComEd (Illinois), PECO (Pennsylvania), BGE (Maryland), Pepco/DPL/ACE (DMV). Pure T&D model.

kpis.description_fr: Rate base consolidated. Croissance +9-10%/an driven by ComEd + BGE Maryland. Pure T&D, pas de generation risk.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated rate base. +9-10%/year growth driven by ComEd + BGE Maryland. Pure T&D, no generation risk.

kpis.description_fr: Plan capex 2024-2027 ($38Md, raised vs prior $34.5Md). Grid modernization + data center interconnection.
kpis.description_en: 2024-2027 capex plan ($38B, raised vs prior $34.5B). Grid modernization + data center interconnection.

kpis.description_fr: Enchère capacité PJM 2025-2026 prix x9 ($269/MW-day vs $29). Pas direct benefit (EXC = T&D only) mais signal demand load tightness.
kpis.description_en: PJM 2025-2026 capacity auction price x9 ($269/MW-day vs $29). No direct benefit (EXC = T&D only) but signals load tightness.

kpis.description_fr: Pipeline 16 GW data centers Northern Virginia (Pepco + DPL service area). Plus gros hub data center monde. Interconnection backlog premium.
kpis.description_en: 16 GW data center pipeline Northern Virginia (Pepco + DPL service area). World's largest data center hub. Premium interconnection backlog.

kpis_story.description_fr: Chicago + suburbs Illinois deviennent hub data center #2 USA (post Northern Virginia). ComEd interconnection queue records.
kpis_story.description_en: Chicago + Illinois suburbs become #2 US data center hub (post Northern Virginia). ComEd interconnection queue records.

kpis_story.description_fr: $12Md investissements smart grid 2024-2027 (sensors, automation, undergrounding). Réponse réliability + climate resilience.
kpis_story.description_en: $12B smart grid investments 2024-2027 (sensors, automation, undergrounding). Response to reliability + climate resilience.

_notes: EXC = Exelon, pure-play T&D utility (post Constellation spin 2022). Modèle régulé sans generation risk, data center tailwind.
